full_actual_playbook:
## STRATEGIES & INSIGHTS

[sai-00001] helpful=0 harmful=0 :: For every asset, build an exhaustive eligibility matrix covering each available category-specific exemption and each broad wildcard or general-property exemption. A specific match does not displace an independently applicable general provision.
## FORMULAS & CALCULATIONS

[calc-00002] helpful=0 harmful=0 :: For an independently evaluated asset-exemption pair with asset value V and statutory cap C, report claim_value = min(V, C). If the provision states no monetary cap, report V. Do not reject an otherwise eligible asset merely because V exceeds C.
## CODE SNIPPETS & TEMPLATES

[code-00007] helpful=0 harmful=0 :: Treat each factual asset description as an immutable JSON key: copy the complete description verbatim, including parentheticals, dimensions, color, model, features, caliber, mileage, and use qualifiers. Emit ordinary key-array pairs rather than embedding an entire mapping inside a quoted key.
## COMMON MISTAKES TO AVOID

[err-00005] helpful=0 harmful=0 :: Do not confuse aggregate ceilings with per-item ceilings, and do not import a cap from a neighboring subsection. Read the scope and limit from the exact cited provision.
[err-00006] helpful=0 harmful=0 :: Emit each distinct asset-citation pair once. Separate spousal entitlement or cap stacking may affect the available amount, but it does not create duplicate records for the same statutory basis.
## PROBLEM-SOLVING HEURISTICS

[ph-00003] helpful=0 harmful=0 :: Apply a fixed sequence: honor the solved jurisdiction and any opt-out rule; classify the asset from explicit use facts; test all specific provisions; test all 'any property' provisions; calculate each claim independently; then deduplicate and validate the output.
[ph-00008] helpful=0 harmful=0 :: Perform a final parsed-structure audit: confirm one top-level JSON object, exactly one key per required asset, exact key text, arrays as actual values, vocabulary-authorized citation IDs, required numeric claim_value fields when requested, and no duplicate asset-citation pairs.
## CONTEXT CLUES & INDICATORS

[ctx-00004] helpful=0 harmful=0 :: Treat stated use qualifiers as controlling evidence. Apply the prompt's personal-use default when no contrary fact appears, but require an explicit occupational-use or necessity fact before assigning a trade-tool exemption.
## OTHERS
content_observation: These are mostly whole-task execution procedures: exhaustive eligibility matrix, independent min(V,C), immutable asset keys, cap scope, deduplication, fixed task sequence, parsed-structure audit and use qualifiers. what_to_learn: If later new-case gains support it, learn the procedure-induction mechanism rather than importing an old good bank or weakening ACE. Current direct14 and closed-feedback candidate remains the declared next experiment.
